card.study.name: Study %1$s
card.study.text: A large part of research is simply hitting the books and putting in the work. You study %1$s and gain 15 to 25 progress.
card.reject.name: Reject %1$s findings
card.reject.text: You come to the realization that %1$s is not vital to your current research. You will not gain any more progress in %1$s, or draw any cards related to that category, but your current progress will remain.
card.experimentation.name: Experimentation
card.experimentation.text: You perform some random experiments to see if something can be discovered. Gain 15 to 30 progress in a completely random category.
card.analyze.name: Analyze %1$s
card.analyze.text: By thoroughly analyzing observations you have made about %1$s you might be able to put together a theory based on the collected data. Lose 1 %1$s observation to gain 25 to 50 %1$s progress and 5 %2$s progress.
card.rethink.name: Rethink
card.rethink.text: You take a step back and reassess your findings. You get rid of invalid conclusions and proceed with fresh understanding. Lose 10 progress divided evenly between all current categories, but you regain 1 inspiration and gain a bonus draw.
card.ponder.name: Ponder
card.ponder.text: You carefully consider all you have learned so far. Gain 25 progress divided evenly between all current active categories and a bonus draw.
card.notation.name: Notation
card.notation.text: While making notes of your discoveries thus far you find some errors and correct them. You lose all your progress in %1$s, but most of the lost progress is added to %2$s.
card.balance.name: Universal Theory
card.balance.text: A moment of revelation shows you the common links between all you have been studying. Your total progress is split evenly amongst all currently revealed and valid categories and an additional category will gain the full bonus upon completion.
card.curio.name: Study Curio
card.curio.text: While examining a curio often reveals some interesting information it is much better to study it as part of controlled research.
card.inspired.name: Inspired
card.inspired.text: Inspired by the progress you have made so far, your mind explores paths you have not considered before. You gain %1$s %2$s.
card.concentrate.name: Concentrate
card.concentrate.text: Often much can be learned by concentrating a substance into its purest form. Attempt to concentrate some %1$s essentia. Gain 15 Alchemy and 1 bonus draw. There is also a chance you will gain 1 inspiration.
card.measure.name: Measure
card.measure.text: You take some time to make detailed measurements of various types of essentia and the potential vis they contain. Gain 15 Infusion progress and 1 bonus draw.
card.channel.name: Channel %1$s Essentia
card.channel.text: You set up a simple experiment to examine what happens when you channel %1$s during infusion. Gain 25 Infusion.
card.infuse.name: Experimental Infusion
card.infuse.text: By making assumptions on the results of infusing certain objects with essentia, and then testing those results valuable insight may be gained. You will learn much by combining %1$s essentia with %2$s and then studying the result. Gain %3$s Infusion.
card.tinker.name: Tinker
card.tinker.text: You start tinkering with some devices to find new ways of incorporating them into magical creations. Gain %1$s to %2$s Artifice.
card.focus.name: Spiritual Focus
card.focus.text: You focus your mind on the magical and spiritual energy around you, hoping to grow more attuned to its ebb and flow. Gain 15 Auromancy and a bonus draw.
card.darkwhisper.name: Dark Whispers
card.darkwhisper.text: The brain in a jar has been very talkative lately. It promises you ancient secrets for all your experience. Can you trust it?

research.AUROMANCY_INTRO.stage.1: Shape vis through foci and casters.
research.ALCHEMY_INTRO.title: Alchemy
research.ALCHEMY_INTRO.stage.1: Dissolve and remake matter in boiling essentia. Heat, water, and primal salts unlock catalysts that ordinary crafting cannot touch. Treat the crucible as a living equation — spill carelessly and flux answers.
research.CRUCIBLE.title: Crucible
research.CRUCIBLE.stage.1: Heat, water, and aspects transmute a catalyst thrown in.
research.ESSENTIATUBE.title: Essentia Tubes
research.ESSENTIATUBE.stage.1: Glass tubes and valves move essentia between jars.
research.NITORALUM.title: Nitor and Alumentum
research.NITORALUM.stage.1: Light and fuel distilled from primal fire.
research.ARTIFICE_INTRO.title: Artifice
research.ARTIFICE_INTRO.stage.1: Infusion remakes matter through will. Arrange pedestals around a matrix, feed aspects from jars, and hold your focus until the work completes. Each success teaches patience; each failure stains the aura.
research.INFUSIONARTIFICE.title: Artifice: Infusion Craft
research.INFUSIONARTIFICE.stage.1: Matrix, pedestals, and nearby essentia remake an item over time.
research.ESSENTIAVALVE.title: Essentia Valve
research.ESSENTIAVALVE.stage.1: A redstone-powered valve closes the essentia pipe network.
research.RESEARCHTABLE.title: Research Table
research.RESEARCHTABLE.stage.1: Study observations into theory; notes accelerate insight.
research.MIRROR.title: Magic Mirror
research.MIRROR.stage.1: Link two mirrors to step across space in the same world.
research.LEVITATOR.title: Arcane Levitator
research.LEVITATOR.stage.1: A column of force lifts entities above the device.
research.GOLEMANCY_INTRO.title: Golemancy
research.GOLEMANCY_INTRO.stage.1: Seals and materials command animated servants.
research.GOLEMJOBS.title: Golem Jobs
research.GOLEMJOBS.stage.1: FILL and EMPTY move stacks; GATHER, HARVEST, USE, and BUTCHER expand labor.
research.GOLEMMATERIAL.title: Golem Materials
research.GOLEMMATERIAL.stage.1: Iron and thaumium upgrades harden the walker.
research.GOLEMCORE.title: Golem Cores
research.GOLEMCORE.stage.1: Cores extend gather range or harden guard strikes.
research.GOLEMSEALS_ADV.title: Advanced Seals
research.GOLEMSEALS_ADV.stage.1: Harvest ripe crops, flip levers, or butcher livestock on command.
research.ELDRITCH_INTRO.title: Eldritch Studies
research.ELDRITCH_INTRO.stage.1: Beyond warp lies void metal and stranger shores. Eldritch stone hums where the veil thins, and crimson rites speak of doors that should stay shut. Study carefully — the Outer Lands notice those who stare too long.
research.VOIDGEAR.title: Void Gear
research.VOIDGEAR.stage.1: Void metal tools and armor thirst and self-repair.
research.WARPGEAR.title: Warping Attire
research.WARPGEAR.stage.1: Robes and curios that invite permanent warp.
research.OUTERLANDS_TEASE.title: Outer Lands
research.OUTERLANDS_TEASE.stage.1: A distant realm waits beyond the veil — for now, only glimpses.
research.INFUSION.title: Infusion
research.INFUSION.stage.1: Bind components around a matrix to remake an item.
research.ELDRITCH.title: Beyond the Void
research.ELDRITCH.stage.1: Strange stone deep underground hums with emptiness.
research.ELDRITCH.stage.2: Warp draws guardians; void seeds crystallize from their stone.
research.GOLEMBASIC.title: Golemancy
research.GOLEMBASIC.stage.1: Animate a wooden servant and bind it with seals.
research.GOLEMBASIC.stage.2: Place gather or guard seals on walls for stay golems to find.
research.GREATWOOD.title: Greatwood
research.GREATWOOD.stage.1: Towering magical trees grow in forests. Their planks craft well.
research.SILVERWOOD.title: Silverwood
research.SILVERWOOD.stage.1: Pale trees that calm the aura. Nodes gather near their trunks.

warp.text.2: A sudden and unnatural hunger consumes you.
warp.text.6: A thick fog appears from nowhere. Something stirs in its depths.
warp.text.9: You suddenly feel reluctant to break things.
warp.text.11: What was that noise? Something is behind you.
warp.text.13: Something is watching you. Maybe it is time to stop.
warp.text.14: You have a moment of clarity.
warp.text.15: Your stomach suddenly gurgles very strangely.
warp.text.16: The shadows crawl with hungry minds.
warp.text.17: A greater presence tears through the veil.
warp.text.19: Something just stepped where you cannot see.
warp.text.21: The veil thins. Do not look back.
warp.text.22: Crimson eyes watch from the mist.
warp.text.24: You hear rain that isn't falling.
